info.title: Client Portal Platform API
info.description:
API for the Client Portal Platform. Covers three access contexts:
- **Organization management**: org members manage portals and internal users
- **Portal administration**: internal users manage request types, workflows, and process requests
- **Client portal**: citizens self-register on a specific portal and submit requests

**Authentication**: All endpoints not marked `security: []` require a Bearer JWT.
Any authenticated endpoint can return `401` if the token is missing or invalid,
even when not explicitly listed in that operation's responses.

**Pagination**: Collections that may grow unboundedly (users, requests) return a
paginated envelope `{ data: [], pagination: {} }`. Small, naturally bounded
collections (roles, departments, permissions, request types, workflow tasks) return
bare arrays. This is intentional and consistent.

**Spec vs URL version**: `info.version` (2.0.0) tracks the document revision.
The URL prefix `/api/v1` is the API routing version — these two numbers are
independent and can diverge as the spec evolves.

post.summary: Sign up and create a new organization
post.description:
Creates a new organization and registers the caller as its Org Super Admin.
A verification email is sent to the provided address.
The account cannot be used to sign in until the email is verified.

Exchanges the token from the verification email for a confirmed account.
After successful verification the user is authenticated and receives a JWT.

204.description: Verification email resent (same response whether the email exists or not)

post.summary: Sign in as an org member
post.description:
Password-based sign-in for internal org members.
Returns 403 if the account exists but email is not yet verified.
Requires org.portals.manage permission.

delete.description:
Soft-deletes the portal. All data (requests, request types, users) is
preserved but the portal becomes inaccessible.
Requires org.portals.manage permission.

post.description:
Creates an internal user account and sends an invitation email.
Org users can only be added internally — no self-registration at org level.
Requires org.users.manage permission.

delete.description:
Soft-deletes by setting status = inactive. Historical data is preserved.
Requires org.users.manage permission.

post.description:
Grants an existing org user access to this portal and optionally assigns portal roles.
The user must already be an org member.
Requires portal.users.manage permission.

Removes portal access. Historical data (assigned tasks, follow-ups) is preserved.
Requires portal.users.manage permission.

post.summary: Stage a file before request submission
post.description:
Uploads a file and returns a short-lived stagedFileId (TTL: 1 hour).
Use when filling out a request form with file_upload fields: upload each
document here first, then include the returned stagedFileId as the fieldValue
when submitting the request. The backend materializes staged files as proper
request attachments at creation time. Unused staged files are garbage-collected
after TTL expires.
Accepted types: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, application/pdf.

get.summary: List all requests in a portal
get.description:
Requires portal.requests.view or portal.requests.manage permission.
Results are silently filtered by the caller's ABAC scope constraints:
- `departmentIds` scope: only requests whose request type belongs to those departments
- `onlyAssignedToSelf` scope: only requests assigned to the caller

post.description: Requires portal.requests.manage permission.

get.summary: List follow-up messages on a request (internal view)

200.description: Full follow-up thread including internal-only messages

post.description:
Creates a follow-up message on the request thread.
If the message includes file attachments, post the follow-up first to obtain
the followUpId, then upload each file via
POST /portals/{portalId}/requests/{requestId}/follow-ups/{followUpId}/attachments.
Requires portal.requests.manage permission.

post.summary: Upload an attachment to a follow-up message (internal user)
post.description:
Attaches a file to an existing follow-up. Follow-up attachments are kept
separate from request-level attachments and only appear in the thread.
Client sequencing: create the follow-up first, then upload files.
Attempting to upload before the follow-up exists will return 404.

201.description: Attachment uploaded and linked to the follow-up

post.summary: Upload an attachment to a request
post.description: Requires portal.requests.manage permission.

get.summary: List task instances for a request
get.description:
Requires portal.requests.view or portal.requests.manage permission.
Results are silently filtered by the caller's ABAC scope constraints:
- `onlyAssignedToSelf` scope: only task instances assigned to the caller

post.summary: Mark a task instance as complete
post.description:
Completing a task triggers evaluation of the workflow graph: tasks whose
dependencies are now fully satisfied are activated. If this is the last task,
the request moves to `completed`.

When `outcome` is `clarification_requested`, the workflow pauses and the request
moves to `pending_clarification` until the citizen responds via the client
follow-up endpoint with type `clarification_response`.

When `outcome` is `rejected`, the request moves to `rejected` and no further
tasks are activated. Requires portal.requests.manage permission.

userId.description: Must be an existing org user

message.example: Verification email sent. Please check your inbox.

Citizen.description: External user with access to a specific client portal; no RBAC role

token.description: Bearer JWT scoped to this portal's client context

Scope.description:
ABAC constraints applied to a portal-level role assignment.
Constraints are defined by the platform; orgs configure values, not rules.
All constraints are optional and composable. Omitting a constraint means
no restriction on that dimension.

departmentIds.description:
Restricts the assignment to resources belonging to these departments.
Applies to: request types, workflows, departments, requests.
Omit or set to null for access across all departments.

onlyAssignedToSelf.description:
When true, restricts request and task access to records assigned to this user.
Applies to: requests, task instances.

RoleAssignment.description: A role granted to a portal user, optionally scoped by ABAC constraints

scope.description: Null means no scope constraints; the role applies to all resources
Omit or set to null to grant access without scope constraints

OrgPermission.description:
- org.users.manage: add/update/deactivate org users; assign org roles
- org.portals.manage: create/update/archive portals

PortalPermission.description:
- portal.users.manage: add/remove portal users; assign portal roles
- portal.settings.manage: update portal settings and notification rules
- portal.request_types.view: read-only access to request types and fields
- portal.request_types.manage: create/update/archive request types
- portal.workflows.view: read-only access to workflow definitions
- portal.workflows.manage: create/replace workflow definitions
- portal.departments.manage: create/update/delete departments
- portal.requests.view: read-only access to all requests and tasks
- portal.requests.manage: process requests, complete tasks, add follow-ups

PermissionDefinition.description: Metadata for a system permission used to build role configuration UIs

description.example: Process requests, complete tasks, and add follow-up messages

permissions.description: Permission keys assigned to this role

isDefault.description: True for system-seeded roles; these cannot be deleted

permissions.description: Permission keys to assign; must all match the role's level

magicLinkEnabled.description: When true, citizens may sign up and sign in via magic link

details.description: Optional structured context (field-level info, conflict reason, etc.)

FieldType.description:
- text: single-line text input
- textarea: multi-line text input
- single_dropdown: select exactly one option
- multi_select: select one or more options
- file_upload: named document slot; citizen uploads a file and the returned
  stagedFileId is submitted as the field value

options.description: Required when type is single_dropdown or multi_select; not used for file_upload

RequestStatus.description:
- open: submitted, not yet acted on
- in_progress: one or more tasks are active
- pending_clarification: workflow paused; awaiting citizen response
- completed: all workflow tasks approved and finished
- rejected: rejected by a task assignee
- cancelled: cancelled by the citizen or internal user

stagedFileId.description: Include as fieldValue for file_upload fields at request submission time

TaskInstanceStatus.description:
- waiting: dependencies not yet met
- active: ready for action
- completed: finished (see outcome)
- skipped: bypassed due to upstream rejection or cancellation

TaskOutcome.description:
- approved: workflow continues
- rejected: request moves to `rejected`; no further tasks activate
- clarification_requested: request moves to `pending_clarification`;
  a follow-up of type `clarification_request` is created automatically

FollowUpType.description:
- message: general communication
- clarification_request: created automatically when a task outcome is `clarification_requested`
- clarification_response: citizen reply; resumes workflow and moves request back to `in_progress`

NotificationEvent.description:
- consumer_registered: new citizen account created
- request_submitted: citizen submits a new request
- task_assigned: a task is activated and assigned
- task_handover: a task is completed and the next task(s) activate
- clarification_requested: assignee requests more information from the citizen
- clarification_responded: citizen replies to a clarification request
- request_completed: all tasks approved; request finished
- request_rejected: request rejected by an assignee
- request_cancelled: request cancelled

rules.description:
One rule per event. Events not listed use the default (both assignee
and requester notified). Replacing the full settings replaces all rules.
